title: DataEntity
description: IT domain composite for DataEntity, materializing its applicable cross-framework facets. Typing: extends DataEntity (rootless — qualifier/data roles only). Facets are mounted as optional named properties keyed by lowerCamelCase of the facet's title (the catalogue's facet mount rule — instance-level namespacing; JSON Schema does not namespace instance properties. Mount-key distinctness within one composite is the author's responsibility now that titles are no longer framework-prefixed). Mounted facets — attributed-to: Attribution; measured-by-data-quality: DataAccessibility, DataAccuracy, DataAvailability, DataCompleteness, DataCompliance, DataConfidentiality, DataConsistency, DataCredibility, DataCurrentness, DataEfficiency, DataPortability, DataPrecision, DataRecoverability, DataTraceability, DataUnderstandability. Source: hand-authored, TOGAF data-architecture stratum.
